suite.name: gemma4-31b-cpu-apple-m5-max
suite.description: Gemma 4 31B (dense 60-layer, 50 sliding-window + 10 global attention layers) on Apple M5 Max CPU (18 physical cores: 6 Super + 12 Performance, 36 GB unified memory), run natively on macOS ARM64 across LiteRT-LM (XNNPACK, YNNPACK, YNNPACK-SDPA) and llama.cpp (CPU-only with KleidiAI + Accelerate) on the INT4 track.

apple-m5-max.threads_note: 12 threads for matched comparison; 18 threads (all 6 Super + 12 Performance physical cores) empirically fastest for both llama.cpp and LiteRT-LM on Gemma 4 31B.
apple-m5-max.machine_notes: Apple M5 Max (18-core CPU: 6 Super + 12 Performance, 36 GB unified memory), native macOS ARM64 CPU (no container)

llama.cpp.selected_by: probe at 6/12/16/18 threads x {mmap, --no-mmap, --no-repack} x {GGML_KLEIDIAI_SME=0,1}; GGML_KLEIDIAI_SME=0 + --no-mmap avoids 36 GB KleidiAI SME repack footprint expansion and mmap double-residency on the 36 GB host

litert-lm.selected_by: probe at 6/12/16/18 threads x {XNNPACK, YNNPACK}; 18 physical cores gives lowest end-to-end latency

configs.quant_note: Official Google QAT Q4_0 GGUF (google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf) on CPU with KleidiAI NEON/i8mm + Accelerate (12 threads, --no-mmap, GGML_KLEIDIAI_SME=0 to stay within 36 GB RAM)
Official ggml-org Q4_0 GGUF (ggml-org/gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF) on CPU with KleidiAI NEON/i8mm + Accelerate, flash-attn, batch=2048, 18 threads, --no-mmap
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, blockwise-32 dynamic_wi4b32_afp32 exported from google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized via litert-torch) with XNNPACK delegate (12 threads)
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, blockwise-32 dynamic_wi4b32_afp32) with XNNPACK delegate across all 18 physical cores
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, blockwise-32 dynamic_wi4b32_afp32) with YNNPACK delegate (--ynnpack / --enable_ynnpack=true, 12 threads; YNNPACK falls back to XNNPACK for blockwise-quantized FC ops)
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, blockwise-32 dynamic_wi4b32_afp32) with YNNPACK delegate (--ynnpack / --enable_ynnpack=true, 18 threads; YNNPACK falls back to XNNPACK for blockwise-quantized FC ops)

LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, blockwise-32 dynamic_wi4b32_afp32 with odml.sdpa_transposed composite + bool mask) with YNNPACK delegate (--ynnpack / --enable_ynnpack=true, 18 threads; YNNPACK executes SDPA/non-FC ops with SME2 and falls back to XNNPACK for blockwise-quantized FC ops)
